preconditions.description: Attacker must hold at least some TOFU tokens to initiate a transfer
Contract's totalSupply must be greater than 5,000,000,000e9 (5 billion tokens with 9 decimals) for the buggy burn logic to activate

violation_target.exploit_hint: When totalSupply > 5,000,000,000e9, the _transfer function incorrectly deducts burnFee twice from the sender's balance while only burning it once. Call transfer() with any amount to trigger the bug: 1) burnFee = amount * 2/100, 2) newAmount = amount - burnFee, 3) balances[_from] is reduced by newAmount, 4) then balances[_from] is reduced AGAIN by burnFee, 5) but totalSupply is only reduced by burnFee once. This creates an inconsistency where totalSupply doesn't match actual token balances. The exploit demonstrates the logic error by showing totalSupply remains higher than it should be relative to actual balances.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The _transfer function incorrectly deducts burnFee twice from sender's balance while only burning it once when totalSupply > 5,000,000,000e9. This creates an accounting inconsistency where totalSupply doesn't match the sum of all balances.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Acquire TOFU tokens via getTokens() with ETH. 2. Transfer tokens to trigger the buggy burn logic. 3. Demonstrate the inconsistency by showing totalSupply > sum of balances.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Use deal() to give attacker ETH. 2. Call getTokens() with ETH to acquire TOFU tokens. 3. Transfer some tokens to another address to trigger the bug. 4. Calculate sum of all balances and compare with totalSupply.
